name: requirement
description: 接收用户需求输入：优先读取 targetDir 下的 requirement.md；若不存在，则把用户的提示词原文落盘为 run/requirement.md。两者都缺则向用户索取。

prompt.instruction: If targetDir/requirement.md exists, copy it verbatim to run/requirement.md. Otherwise, take the user's most recent prompt that triggered this skill and write it under a '# Requirement' heading to run/requirement.md. If neither is available, halt the pipeline and ask the user for the requirement.
guardrails: Never rewrite or summarize the user's requirement; copy it verbatim.
